title: Design: A/R Collection with groups closed matches the pictures in both themes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in this report at two locations, so the Location chip shows.
  • Make sure your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on, so the credit term shows.
  • Make sure that at least ten customers have overdue invoices on today's date, each with a phone number and a credit term.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every group collapsed.
  • Open the design pictures "Info icon beside the title, light" (ar-ap-p6-info-icon-beside-the-title-light.png) and "Info icon beside the title, dark" (ar-ap-p6-info-icon-beside-the-title-dark.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.

Setup

  1. Make customer 1: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type a new Name for customer 1, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, fill Make and the other boxes the window marks as required, then click Save.
  2. Make invoice for customer 1: On customer 1's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete; in Tech stories type a story and click Complete All Lines (if Missing Details asks for Mileage, type it and click Complete All Lines again). Open the Finance tab and click Mark Reviewed (if a window asks for the VIN, type one and click Confirm Review). Type the date 45 days before today in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  3. Make customers 2 to 10: Same way as customer 1 and its invoice, nine more times (a new Name, a Phone and Credit Terms "Net 30" each), so ten customers have an overdue invoice.
custom_steps:
1. Compare the title row and the filter row with the light picture.
  2. Look at the chevron in the table's top-left header cell.
  3. Compare the customer group rows with the light picture.
  4. Compare the Totals row with the light picture.
  5. Switch ShopView to dark theme.
  6. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The title "A/R Aging Collection", the info icon directly right of it and the "⋯" at the right end, all on one line.
  • The filter row below.

Step 2:

  • It points right: every group is closed. It is blue, the same blue as the group rows' chevrons.

Step 3:

  • Each group row: a blue chevron pointing right, the bold name with its count, grey "Phone: " and the number and "Credit term: " and the term, "Total" under Past due and the two bold sums.

Step 4:

  • "Totals" with the two bold sums at the bottom.

Step 5:

  • The page switches to dark theme, as in the dark picture: dark page and white text.
  • The "As of" and "Location" chips are dark-blue pills with white text.
  • "Customer" and "Past due" are white text with no fill.
  • Phone and Credit term grey, everything readable.

Step 6:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.
  • The layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 13 (13 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 13 Nov 2026, version re-checked 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout), story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S8-R1: “Each report has the native report info icon (the one Work In Progress and Technician Utilization use) directly right of its title. Hovering, keyboard focus or a tap shows the report's description in a tooltip; moving away or Escape closes it. The descriptions:”
  • S8-R2: “The title, its info icon and the Export menu stay on one line at 1440 pixels wide; the filter row sits below them, positioned as on the native reports.”
  • S9-R1: “On A/R Collection, each customer's group row shows, after the customer's name, "Phone: " and the customer's phone number as the customer card shows it.”
  • S9-R2: “For users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch, the group row also shows "Credit term: " and the customer's credit term as the customer card shows it ("COD" when none is set).”
  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group. The chevron is blue, the same as each group's own chevron (S4-R5).”
  • S4-R5: “Each group's own expand toggle uses the same chevron: pointing down when open, right when closed. Behavior is unchanged.”
  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”

Partly checked against build v26.45.2-6a8b89c (QA site sv11315) on 11/10/2026; not yet seen on that build: the header chevron's blue colour (added 14 Nov 2026 for PRD version 13).

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p6-info-icon-beside-the-title-light.png: figure "Info icon beside the title, light" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p6-info-icon-beside-the-title-dark.png: figure "Info icon beside the title, dark" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p7-a-r-collection-date-and-customer-only.png: figure "A/R Collection: date and customer only" (Production (before)), board "7. Filters and call list" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "The native report info icon sits right of the title; title, icon and ⋯ stay on one line, filter row below. S8-R1, S8-R2." (caption of "Info icon beside the title, light")
  • "Same in dark mode. S8-R1." (caption of "Info icon beside the title, dark")
  • "Collection and Unpaid Invoices have a customer or vendor picker, and their Totals row ignores it. No phone or credit term on the customer rows." (caption of "A/R Collection: date and customer only")

Difference from the PRD (DD-05), closed: PRD version 5 said "the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline" (S7-R7); the design shows document numbers and customer and vendor names are blue at the same (regular) weight as the plain text beside them. Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 15): semi-bold, exactly as Work In Progress links look today. The design's "Links only where they can open" picture was reshot on 23 Oct 2026 (round 15) and published on 5 Nov 2026; its caption now reads "Native link style: the Work In Progress blue, semi-bold, no underline." This case follows the PRD (S7-R7, unchanged in version 11). The held design-version case D-80 (C715562) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).

Difference from the PRD (DD-08), closed: PRD version 12 (12 Nov 2026) says the header chevron "is blue, the same as each group's own chevron (S4-R5)" (S4-R1); the design shows the top-left header chevron in dark grey beside the blue group chevrons (for example in "Expand all from the header", "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices", "Open Balance pinned, light" and "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible"). Closed by the later PRD ruling: PRD version 12 (12 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic) added the chevron's colour to S4-R1 after these pictures were taken, and version 13 (13 Nov 2026, Chris Ward, the design authority) keeps it. Compare the layout with the pictures; the header chevron's colour comes from the PRD.
